tool_input.description: Compile and run scratch program to determine expected outputs
Clean up scratch files and run full test suite

result:
All tests pass (23 tests, 0 failures). I created `src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/time/DurationFormatUtilsAgentTest.java` (JUnit 3.8 style `TestCase`, matching the rest of the project), covering:

- Constructor shape (public, non-final class)
- `formatDurationHMS` / `formatDurationISO` including a negative-duration edge case
- `formatDuration` with/without zero-padding, literal text in the pattern, a zero duration, and a `null` format triggering `NullPointerException`
- `formatDurationWords` across all four suppression combinations, singular/plural boundaries (exactly 1 day/hour/minute/second), and partial-zero-field cases
- `formatPeriodISO` and `formatPeriod`, including the below/at/above-28-day calendar-switch boundary and a negative (`start > end`) period that doesn't throw
